title: Tiny Dragon's Bubbly Adventure
originalStory: Tiny Dragon loves to play in the garden, puffing out the brightest, shiniest soap bubbles that float high into the sunny sky. One day, his bubble danced up to a butterfly, and they began a cheerful game of tag through the flowers. Seeing the two friends so happy together made all the garden critters smile, and Tiny Dragon's heart felt warm and content.
visualBible:
Tiny Dragon: small green dragon with shimmering scales and bright eyes
Butterfly: colorful butterfly with blue and yellow wings
Sunflower: tall sunflower with a big, smiling face
Bunny: small brown bunny with fluffy ears

pages.text: In the sunny garden, Tiny Dragon loved to puff out the shiniest soap bubbles. "Watch them float up high!" he giggled, watching the bubbles dance in the sky.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiny Dragon is in a grassy garden, happily blowing shiny soap bubbles that float towards the sunny sky. The garden is filled with colorful flowers and a gentle breeze. Tiny Dragon's face is full of joy.

pages.text: A curious butterfly fluttered by, intrigued by the bubbles. "Can I play too?" she asked. "Of course!" Tiny Dragon replied, his eyes sparkling with excitement.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiny Dragon and Butterfly are in a colorful flower garden. Tiny Dragon is smiling and looking at Butterfly, who is fluttering near him, eager to join the bubble fun. The flowers sway gently in the breeze.

pages.text: Together, they played tag among the sunflowers. The sunflower chuckled, "What a lovely game!" as Tiny Dragon and Butterfly darted around.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiny Dragon and Butterfly are playfully flying around a tall Sunflower in the garden. The Sunflower has a big smiling face as it watches the cheerful game unfold.

pages.text: Garden critters like Bunny watched, smiling warmly. "Your joy is contagious," Bunny said. Tiny Dragon felt his heart glow with happiness.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiny Dragon, Butterfly, and Bunny are in the garden. Bunny sits safely at a distance, watching with a warm smile. The garden is peaceful, with flowers all around, and the scene is filled with happiness.
